description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: apikey

API for Prisma Optimize, a query performance analysis tool for debugging and improving database queries during development. Optimize captures query execution data from Prisma Client via the @prisma/extension-optimize extension, analyzes query patterns, and provides AI-powered recommendations to reduce database load and improve application responsiveness. The service records queries during development sessions and provides performance insights through the Prisma Data Platform Console. Supports PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, CockroachDB, and MS SQL Server.
